description: Na₂CS₃ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six S atoms. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.88-3.13 Å. C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three S atoms. There are two shorter (1.72 Å) and one longer (1.73 Å) C-S bond length. There are two inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded to four equivalent Na and one C atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing SNa₄C trigonal bipyramids. In the second S site, S is bonded to four equivalent Na and one C atom to form a mixture of distorted corner, edge, and face-sharing SNa₄C square pyramids.
